cohort: 90 pregnant women aged 18 to 40 years with ultrasonography (USG)-documented uterine fibroids, excluding those with adnexal pathologies, previous uterine surgery, or obstetrical comorbidities, visiting Hayatabad Medical Complex Peshawar, Pakistan
finding: Uterine fibroids during pregnancy are associated with increased risks of complications such as abortion, premature rupture of membranes, and postpartum hemorrhage, often requiring cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was common, primarily due to PROM (premature rupture of membranes) and malpresentation.
birth_weight: low birth weight (specific values not provided)
